extensionDescription: Read bilingual webpages using official Sign in with ChatGPT and your eligible plan usage.
introTitle:
Keep the page.
Read another language.
introSubtitle: Original and translation, side by side.
accountUsage: Use your ChatGPT account and eligible plan usage.
setupBody: Run install-macos.command from the download (install-dia-macos.command for Dia) once to install the local sign-in component. No API key required.
nodeRequirement: Requires Node.js 22+. See the README for Linux installation.
settingsHint:
Translates as you read, including dynamic content.
Changes apply the next time you start translation.
privacyHint: Translation sends page text to OpenAI. Passwords and input fields are skipped. New tabs are not translated automatically.
guideTitle: From sign-in to reading in three steps
guideInstall: Install the local component, then sign in with ChatGPT above.
guideAuthorize: Allow eligible ChatGPT plan usage on the official consent page, then choose an available model.
guideRead: Open a webpage and click Leaf Translate in the toolbar to start bilingual reading.
limitations: Long pages translate near the viewport. Links, lists and tables keep their structure. Pause or restore the original at any time. Browser internal pages, PDFs, text in images, iframes and shadow DOM are not supported.
shortcut: Shortcut: Alt + Shift + T. Change it in your browser’s extension shortcut settings.
footer: Read slowly. The world is wide.
welcomeBody: Eligible translation requests use your ChatGPT plan or authorized usage allowance. Availability and limits depend on your account. Manage this app’s usage and authorization in ChatGPT settings.
usingPlan: Translation uses your ChatGPT plan allowance.
allowPlan: Allow this app to use your plan on the official consent page.
noApiKey: No API key needed. ChatGPT manages your allowance.
